name: Healthcare & RPM Microservices Backend
description: Enterprise-grade Healthcare & Remote Patient Monitoring backend microservices ecosystem featuring Java 17, Spring Boot 3.4, Realtime WebSocket/STOMP Chat Service with Redis Pub/Sub, AWS Tokyo Fargate Cost Telemetry, Keycloak 24 IAM, Prometheus & Grafana Observability, Kafka Transactional Outbox, Saga Orchestration, Redisson Distributed Locking, and Elasticsearch Telemetry.
